title: Shingata Kururin Pa!
overview:
Four years later from a previous Kururinpa tournament, the next one is to be held shortly. Ten challengers from all over the world have come to get the opportunity to meet King Paro-Paru, who is the host of the event and can make any of the winner's wishes come true. Who will be the winner this year...?

Shingata Kururin Pa! refines the original game's formula with a few new features. This time around, if a fire block is dropped in a place where it has nothing to burn, it will smolder in place until a nearby fire helps it burst into flames; this allows the player to build some much more complex combos. Each character now also has a unique block type with its own effects.
